channel.title: Garden Rescue
channel.desc: Charlie Dimmock and Lee Burkhill are in Manchester to transform Mona and Qurban's awkward L-shaped, building-site garden into a Moroccan courtyard. They would love a garden that has the atmosphere of country, geometric and with warm colours, Majorelle blue pots and Islamic motifs, so they can create a space that echoes their travels and which they can share with their children. Can the team achieve all this on a ?5,000 budget?
